note: Inline Block Title Automatic is a runtime Layout Builder form alter with NO persistent config. It alters the layout_builder_add_block and layout_builder_update_block forms via FormAlter::blockAddConfigureAlter(): for reusable block_content and inline blocks it converts settings.label and settings.label_display to #type=>'value' (hidden), defaults the label to 'Inline block', and forces label_display #default_value to FALSE. Medium/hard cases are grounded by BUILDING the real AddBlockForm (Drupal\layout_builder\Form\AddBlockForm) for an inline block on a Layout-Builder-enabled namespaced content type (ibta_*) and inspecting the element #type/#default_value; the module's effect is visible only when Layout Builder is enabled on the display and the module is enabled.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module inline_block_title_automatic changes the Layout Builder block forms. Which two form ids does it alter, and what does it do to the block's 'label' (placement title) and 'label_display' form elements?
evals.expected_output: It alters layout_builder_add_block and layout_builder_update_block. It converts $form['settings']['label'] and $form['settings']['label_display'] to hidden #type => 'value' elements, defaulting the label to 'Inline block' and forcing label_display #default_value to FALSE so no placement title is shown.

evals.prompt: Does inline_block_title_automatic affect every block placed in Layout Builder, or only certain ones? How does it decide?
evals.expected_output: Only block_content blocks: reusable library blocks where $form['settings']['provider']['#value'] === 'block_content', and inline blocks where $form['settings']['block_form']['#block'] is a BlockContent entity. System blocks, views blocks, etc. are left untouched.

evals.prompt: How do I configure inline_block_title_automatic, and what does the inline block's placement title default to once it's enabled?
evals.expected_output: There is nothing to configure (no settings form, config, or permission - configure is null). You just enable the module along with Layout Builder. When an inline block's placement label is empty the module defaults it to 'Inline block', and it forces the title not to display.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type 'ibta_m1' has Layout Builder enabled. Inspect the live Layout Builder 'Add block' form for an inline block on ibta_m1's layout and state whether the block placement 'Title' (label) field is editable or hidden. Is inline_block_title_automatic active here?
evals.expected_output: The Title/label field is hidden: on the built AddBlockForm $form['settings']['label']['#type'] is 'value' (not a textfield), so inline_block_title_automatic is active. label_display is likewise a 'value' element forced to FALSE.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type 'ibta_m2' has Layout Builder enabled. When adding an inline block to ibta_m2's layout, is the block title set to display or not, and what default placement label does a new inline block get? Inspect the live add-block form to answer.
evals.expected_output: The title is forced NOT to display: $form['settings']['label_display']['#default_value'] is FALSE (and its #type is 'value'). A new inline block's placement label defaults to 'Inline block'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure content type 'ibta_h1' to use Layout Builder so that, thanks to inline_block_title_automatic, the placement Title field is automatically hidden when adding an inline block. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable Layout Builder on node.ibta_h1.default ($display->enableLayoutBuilder()->save()). With inline_block_title_automatic enabled, the built AddBlockForm for an inline block has $form['settings']['label']['#type'] === 'value'. Verify builds that form and checks the label is a hidden 'value' element.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, set up content type 'ibta_h2' with Layout Builder and confirm that inline block placement titles are not displayed (the 'Display title' control is removed and defaults to off). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable Layout Builder on node.ibta_h2.default. With inline_block_title_automatic enabled, the built AddBlockForm for an inline block has $form['settings']['label_display']['#type'] === 'value' and #default_value === FALSE. Verify builds that form and checks both.
